characterList.description: A young man with blonde hair and round silver glasses. Initially wears a black jacket over a grey shirt, later changes to a beige button-up shirt with brown stripes. Notably has a pimple on his lip.
characterList.name: Matt

characterList.description: A young woman with long, dark, curly hair and round clear glasses. Starts in a grey shirt and green pants, later changes into a black puffer jacket with fur hood and black tights. Wears a black jumper and striped long-sleeve shirt at the stadium.
characterList.name: Kaylee

content_metadata.description: Matt and Kaylee's engaging and humorous vlog documenting their journey from snowy Chicago to New Orleans to watch a basketball game between the Pelicans and the Detroit Pistons. The video showcases their travels, game experience, and interactions with fans.

qAndA.answer: They believe the referees made bad calls during the recent Saints game, which negatively impacted the team's performance.
qAndA.question: Why are the New Orleans fans upset at the referees during the basketball game?
